videos.script: An antivirus asks one question. Is this file bad? {{file}} An intruder who uses the tools already on the machine never gives it a file to answer about. {{shell}} So ask a different question. What is this machine doing, and does its job ever need that? {{tree}} The portal never starts a shell. It never downloads anything. It never runs a program from the temporary directory. {{sensor}} In this lesson you build a small sensor that writes down every process, with the processes above it. {{rules}} Three rules read that record. You stage a harmless incident in your own lab, and the rules tell the story in three lines. {{isolate}} Then you respond. Keep the evidence, stop the process, and cut the machine off the network, all but the one door you need. {{product}} And at every weakness of the small one, you will see what a real product does instead.
